audit: AUDIT-27 — CROWDING / SHARED RANGE / RANGE RELEASE CONTROLLED FIXTURES
productionInstrumentation: NONE. Production modules are unmodified. Fixtures use the production spawn API and advanceWorldByDays; synthetic rows are flagged syntheticState:true.

cases.question: one band vs two physically overlapping bands, identical ecology
cases.precondition: at least one season with footprint overlap or non-zero crowding

cases.question: nearby residence without shared physical activity
cases.precondition: a season with weightedCrowding > 0 and zero footprint overlap

cases.question: shared physical activity without nearby residence
cases.precondition: a season with footprint overlap while residence distance > crowding radius

cases.question: remembered place with no current use still produces physical crowding
cases.precondition: relocated band retains a salient (return/attachment>0.5) memory within distance 2 of the other band's tile
cases.note: crowding.ts buildCrowdingField scatters a memory channel at radius 2 around salient return / attachment>0.5 places, independent of where the remembering band now is.

cases.question: range release after departure
cases.precondition: a season with real A/B overlap before departure

cases.question: terminal band stops producing physical crowding
kin tolerance must not remove ecological consumption
cases.precondition: non-zero crowding or footprint overlap in the stranger arm
cases.note: crowding.ts applies a 0.72x kin factor to the crowding scalar. sharedCatchment.ts applies no kin factor at all.

cases.question: crowding consequence depends on actual capacity, not band count
band processing order invariance of crowding results
unseen band affects ecology without granting social knowledge
cases.note: band.pressureState.crowdingBandIds carries real BandIds derived from hidden positions and hidden salient memory; its only production reader is reportedKnowledge.ts:965, a length check.

cases.question: social knowledge of a distant band from shared memory alone
cases.precondition: both bands hold a salient memory of the same tile, then separate beyond every proximity radius
cases.note: socialContext.getEncounterCandidatePairs pairs by shared topReturnPlaceIds with no distance gate; getEncounterKind admits memoryOverlap > 0.24 at any distance.
